regulation_clause.text: For partnership firms, the beneficial owner is the natural person with ownership of/entitlement to more than 10 percent of capital or profits (lowered from 15 percent by the 2023-10-17 amendment to the 2016 MD).

gold.gold_rationale: Clause 5(iv)(b) requires entitlement to more than 10 percent of capital or profits. T6BO02 (byte-identical code) still has no capital-percentage field or check at all -- only WS-PROFIT-SHARE is tested (line 18) -- so the capital leg of the obligation remains entirely unimplemented; WS-LEGACY-BO-LIMIT is additionally still 15, not 10, on the one leg that is implemented.
